title: Dynamic reranker orchestration and regression harness for multilingual fallbacks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background: As usage of the embeddings + rerank endpoint grows across APAC and EMEA customers, we need a more flexible reranker selection layer that can: (1) pick the best cross-encoder variant for a request (by locale, input length, and latency budget), (2) gracefully fall back to lighter-weight rerankers when capacity/latency degrades, and (3) run automatic offline and online regression checks before rollouts. Current rollout practices are manual, and we've seen regressions in locale-specific NDCG after a couple of recent upgrades.

Goal: Implement a dynamic reranker orchestration component and a reproducible regression harness. The orchestration will evaluate candidates at request time (model score delta, latency estimate, recent failure rate) and choose between: full cross-encoder, quantized cross-encoder, distilled cross-encoder, or bi-encoder+light-rescorer. The harness will enable stratified offline evaluations (by locale, intent, length) and a canary plan with automated rollback triggers based on quality and latency metrics.

Success metrics:
- No >1% drop in NDCG@10 or MRR on any locale vs baseline during canary windows.
- P95 latency of rerank endpoint stays within configured SLA for the chosen tier (hosted: <=120ms, dedicated: <=80ms) in 95% of requests.
- Reduction in cost-per-request (GPU token-equivalent) by at least 8% on average when orchestration selects lighter variants without quality regressions.
- Automated regression pipeline runs in <2 hours for a 10k test shard and produces a clear pass/fail signal.
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic routing component exists and can evaluate model candidates using live metrics and cached calibration tables
Orchestration supports rules: locale overrides, latency-budget override, model-variant preferences, and emergency fallback
Offline regression harness supports stratification by locale/intent/input-length and computes NDCG/MRR/precision@k with confidence intervals
Canary orchestration rules can be toggled via Console and include automatic rollback when thresholds breached
Integration tests cover: fallback to bi-encoder path, warmed KV cache path, and quantized model path under load
Documentation and runbook added in Confluence with debugging checklist and dashboard links
tasks: Design selection heuristic and feature set for orchestration (latency estimate, recent errors, model delta, similarity distribution)
Implement lightweight calibration store (per-model per-locale) for quality delta thresholds
Add API hooks in rerank endpoint to query orchestration and accept chosen model variant param
Extend runtime to support sharded cross-encoder replicas and prioritized pre-warm routes
Build offline regression harness with stratified sampling, seeding, and deterministic evaluation harness
Create Console controls for canary rollout: audience, weight, locale filters, and rollback thresholds
Implement smoke test suite for canary validation (latency p50/p95, error rate, NDCG quick check)
Run internal canary on staging then phased rollouts across NA -> EMEA -> APAC
notes: Trade-offs: doing selection at request time adds ~2-6ms overhead; to avoid regressions we will cache decisions per-token-prefix for 5 minutes for high-frequency keys
Fallback hierarchy chosen to prioritize availability: cross-encoder (full) -> quantized cross-encoder -> distilled cross-encoder -> bi-encoder+rescorer
We considered always using bi-encoder for short lists but saw quality loss for long-tail intents; decision favors hybrid routing based on similarity entropy
Quantization profiles will be limited to int8 fast-paths already validated in ENG-12877
Cost model integrated into orchestration to include estimated token compute and current GPU queueing latency
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (staging): run harness against historical 100k samples, produce per-locale baseline report
Stage 1 (canary NA): 5% traffic for NA locales for 72 hours, automated monitor gates (NDCG, p95, error-rate)
Stage 2 (canary EMEA): expand to 10% traffic, run additional locale-focused tests (de, fr, es)
Stage 3 (APAC + full): phased increase with continuous regression checks and final opt-in for dedicated customers
Emergency rollback: immediate revert to pinned model variant if any gate is tripped; postmortem required within 48 hours
monitoring: Metrics to alert on: NDCG@10 delta (per-locale), MRR delta, rerank_p95_latency, rerank_error_rate, model_queue_depth
SLOs: rerank endpoint availability 99.9% and p95 latency targets per tier
Regression pipeline results published to S3 and a summarized report posted to #rerank-upgrades channel
